rules.statement: A plaintiff can seek a possessory remedy to quiet possession against acts of disturbance, even if they were not physically dispossessed but had to assert their rights in court.
rules.supporting_quote: "If the opinion which I have just expressed is erroneous I would hold that the equivalent of the possessory remedy 'uti possidetis' is available to the plaintiff to be quieted in possession against acts of disturbance."
